baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first focus noun at 86:1[1] names an overhead enclosure, while the second at 86:1[2] names an arrival associated with night.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath couples a containing field with an event that enters perceptibility after dark. The two nouns therefore form a scene of encounter rather than a static inventory of celestial objects.

activation_trace.role: An upper cover supplies the containing field in which the second focus noun can appear.
A visitor arriving by night supplies the eventive arrival that animates the overhead field.

changed_reading.before: An oath by the sky and an unspecified nocturnal object.
changed_reading.after: An oath by an overhead field precisely as a night-arrival enters and becomes perceptible within it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split inventory for 86:1[1] permits a visible sign read by observation, while 86:1[2] permits a patterned blow.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first noun can function as a sign-bearing display and the second as the knock or impact that makes a signal salient. The oath then joins evidence with the event that calls an observer to read it.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark makes the first focus noun available as an inscribed or marked display.
A sign from which an observer infers a condition gives the display a diagnostic function.
A patterned strike supplies the punctuating impact that announces or produces the readable sign.

changed_reading.before: Two named things are sworn by without specifying a relation between them.
changed_reading.after: A marked field and a punctuating knock form a signal-event whose effects invite discernment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The overhead surface at 86:1[1] is paired with path, layering, and successive-track branches at 86:1[2].
baseline_models.mechanism: The first noun is not empty distance but an upper medium; the second is a course laid through layers and repeated as one trace follows another. This permits a spatial-process reading alongside the night-visitor reading.

activation_trace.role: An upper covering gives the model a bounded medium rather than an abstract void.
An extended way turns the second noun into a traversal through the upper medium.
Layer laid over layer supplies the medium's laminated structure and resistance.
Successive tracks supply ordered repetition rather than a single isolated appearance.

changed_reading.before: A night body appears somewhere in the sky.
changed_reading.after: An ordered traveler or trace advances through a layered overhead medium.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Two branch-distant but mutually reinforcing focus branches at 86:1[1-2] describe overtopping male contact and reproductive covering.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired roots can encode an above-to-below contact that generates an outcome: one pole rises or presses over, and the other performs covering contact. This is not a lexical replacement for either noun, but it is a coherent latent topology carried by both focus inventories.

activation_trace.role: A male rising and pressing over a herd supplies the upper, overtopping pole of contact.
Male reproductive covering supplies the contacting and potentially generative pole.

changed_reading.before: The conjunction merely coordinates sky and night visitor.
changed_reading.after: The conjunction can compress a branch-level topology of overtopping contact and generation, held as exploratory beside the celestial reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated night-arriver is identified through a rising body and a light that penetrates. Arrival is thereby specified as emergence by luminous puncture: something becomes sharply present against, and possibly through, the overhead field.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the initially open category of a night arrival.
Repetition of the night-arriver preserves the focus event while the question delays its specification.
A rising celestial body gives the arrival a visible bearer and upward emergence.
Penetration through an opening supplies a directional crossing rather than passive visibility.
Light that pierces by brilliance makes luminosity the arrival's operative force.

structural_cues: 86:2 repeats the second focus noun inside a delayed-identification question.
86:3 answers with a two-part nominal description, moving from bearer to action-quality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies night arrival, rising body, penetration, and piercing light; I supply the arrow that treats piercing as the mode by which the arrival registers in the sky. A live alternative is simple appositional naming with no implied crossing of a canopy.

changed_reading.before: A generic nocturnal visitor appears beneath the sky.
changed_reading.after: A rising luminous event arrives by puncturing obscurity and sharply registering against the overhead field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's readable-mark and successive-track affordances become an inspection model. An all-encompassing scope places each self under vigilant preservation, and the following command to look makes observation active: the arriving trace can be read as a recurring check or record under the upper field.

activation_trace.role: A condition inferred from a visible sign turns the first focus noun into a readable field.
One track following another supplies the recurring record inspected in that field.
Completeness and enclosure extend the mechanism from one event to an exceptionless scope.
The thing in its own identity supplies the individual unit to which each trace belongs.
Guarding and attentive care assign the trace an oversight function rather than mere spectacle.
A lookout who both watches and guards fuses observation with the preceding preservation.

structural_cues: 86:4 totalizes the claim over every self and assigns an over-positioned guardian.
86:5 immediately converts watching into an imperative directed at the human observer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies readable signs, successive tracks, total scope, individual identity, guarding, and looking; I infer that the focus arrival can function as a recurring inspection or record. Alternatively, the command to look may concern origin alone and leave the focus image purely celestial.

changed_reading.before: The focus presents a striking sign for an observer to notice once.
changed_reading.after: The focus can stage a sign-bearing upper field in which successive arrivals function as vigilant checks or records for each self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The branch-level generative contact latent in both focus roots gains a full causal sequence: measured creation, reproductive fluid, impulsive discharge, and emergence through a bodily interval. The focus pair can therefore carry an above-to-below impact that produces life, without displacing its celestial syntax.

activation_trace.role: Overtopping male pressure supplies the upper pole of the focus pair's generative contact.
Reproductive covering supplies the contacting action latent in the second focus noun.
Origination makes generation, rather than mere collision, the result of the contact.
Male fluid in the womb materializes the reproductive medium implied by the focus branches.
A liquid driven out in one surge gives the contact force and direction.
Passage to the outside supplies the resulting emergence.
An interval between two bounds gives the discharge a constrained channel.
The back and vertebral frame supply one bodily boundary of the channel.
The upper chest region supplies the opposed bodily boundary named in the emergence sequence.

structural_cues: 86:5 asks what the human was made from, and 86:6 answers with passive creation from a forceful fluid.
86:7 continues the same process with emergence from a bounded bodily interval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two reproductive focus branches and then a creation-fluid-discharge-emergence sequence; I infer that the later sequence retroactivates the focus pair as a compressed generative topology. A live alternative is that human generation is only an analogy for power and contributes nothing to the focus nouns' semantics.

changed_reading.before: The sky and visitor are coordinated celestial referents with no productive contact.
changed_reading.after: Their branch relation can also model forceful upper-to-lower contact that issues in generation and emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return first applies to the human and then becomes a property of the sky; the paired earth opens for growth. Against that frame, the focus's strike and habitual-turn branches become a recurrent pulse linking upper return to lower splitting rather than a one-time nocturnal apparition.

activation_trace.role: The upper cover, with its rain-bearing scope, supplies the cycle's source field.
A patterned strike supplies the pulse transmitted from the upper field.
A habitual turn makes the pulse recurrent rather than singular.
Return to a prior state establishes reversibility before the second sky oath.
Repetition of the upper cover makes the second oath explicitly echo the focus field.
Returning rain gives the upper recurrence a material downward transfer.
Soft growth-bearing earth supplies the receiving lower field.
A plant splitting the earth supplies the visible product of recurrent upper impact.

structural_cues: The return term occurs at 86:8 and again inside the sky oath at 86:11.
86:11-12 form a matched sky-and-earth oath pair whose predicates are return and splitting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, returning rain, fertile earth, plant-splitting, and the focus's strike and habitual-turn branches; I infer a causal cycle from upper recurrence to lower emergence. Alternatively, the second oath may be independent and the focus visitor may remain only a star.

changed_reading.before: The night arrival is a single bright event in an otherwise static sky.
changed_reading.after: The arrival can be a recurrent upper pulse whose return crosses into the earth and produces splitting emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The readable sign and striking event become forensic rather than merely visual. Hidden interiors are put under a test that manifests their state, and the later utterance separates decisively rather than entertaining: the focus knock can function as an exposing test and verdict.

activation_trace.role: A visible sign read for an underlying condition supplies the diagnostic surface.
A patterned blow supplies the testing impact applied to that surface.
A trial that makes condition visible converts impact into diagnostic testing.
Something concealed in the interior supplies the object subjected to exposure.
Penetration into hidden matters supplies the testing event's inward reach.
A thing's meaningful indication lets the exposed result itself speak as evidence.
A judgment separating truth from falsehood gives the disclosure a verdictive end.
The negated category of unserious speech blocks a merely playful or decorative reading of the signal.

structural_cues: 86:9 makes hidden interiors the grammatical subject of testing and manifestation.
86:13-14 pairs decisive utterance with an explicit denial of unseriousness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a readable sign, impact, manifesting trial, hidden interior, inward penetration, indication, and judgment; I infer a trajectory from the focus knock to exposure and verdict. Alternatively, these later judicial terms may begin a separate discourse and not retrodefine the focus event.

changed_reading.before: The luminous visitor only displays itself to sight.
changed_reading.after: Its impact can operate as a forensic disclosure that penetrates concealment, manifests condition, and issues in separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A raised designation and a discrete stroke let the focus oath be heard as well as seen. Echo, spoken production, and regulated divisions of speech turn the isolated knock into articulated, separating utterance whose seriousness is explicitly protected.

activation_trace.role: Naming as raised designation gives the first focus noun a vocal and declarative affordance.
A single musical stroke supplies the focus's smallest audible pulse.
Repeated sound or echo lets the single pulse return and acquire sequence.
Speech brought out by articulation converts sound into an uttered message.
Divisions regulating speech and meter organize repeated strokes into meaningful articulation.
Negated frivolous speech constrains the acoustic event as consequential rather than ornamental.

structural_cues: The oath pattern returns at 86:11 before the explicit speech predicate at 86:13.
86:13-14 contrasts segmented, decisive utterance with unserious speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies raised naming, a distinct stroke, echo, articulation, metrical divisions, and seriousness; I infer an acoustic continuity from the focus knock to separating speech. A live alternative is that the sound branches are incidental and the later utterance comments only on revelation, not on the focus image.

changed_reading.before: The oath is a wholly visual scene of sky and light.
changed_reading.after: The oath also sounds like a raised call punctuated by a discrete stroke that returns as serious, articulated separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Upward rivalry and patterned striking in the focus become a contest of timing. The opponent lacks bundled force and aid; matched schemes answer one another; repeated commands for delay make the decisive strike controlled and deferred rather than immediate.

activation_trace.role: Vying upward supplies the focus model's competitive field.
A patterned strike supplies the counteraction within that contest.
A repeated course makes the counteraction schedulable rather than impulsive.
Strength gathered like rope strands is explicitly denied, removing capacity to absorb or answer the stroke.
Aid that makes one prevail is likewise denied, isolating the opponent in the contest.
Human contrivance supplies the first tactical move.
Forceful counter-treatment supplies an answering move with greater control.
Deliberate non-haste makes waiting part of the counteraction's mechanism.
Gentle delay calibrates the final tempo rather than cancelling action.

structural_cues: 86:15-16 mirror the same action noun and verb across two opposed agents.
86:17 repeats the delay command and closes with a further diminutive slowing expression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rivalry, patterned and repeated striking, denied force and aid, paired schemes, and deliberate delay; I infer that the focus arrival can model a timed counterstroke. Alternatively, the closing delay governs judgment only and leaves the celestial event outside the contest.

changed_reading.before: The visitor flashes once without an opponent or schedule.
changed_reading.after: The visitor can figure a controlled counterstroke whose certainty is expressed through measured delay rather than speed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus-only hunting departure and set snare become tactical when the closing context supplies concealment, opposed contrivance, seeking, and deliberate delay. The oath can carry a hunt topology in which apparent freedom of movement occurs inside a prepared capture field.

activation_trace.role: Going out to hunt supplies the activity-space latent in the first focus root.
A set hunting snare supplies the concealed capture mechanism latent in the second focus root.
Contrivance supplies the quarry-side maneuvering within the hunt topology.
The mirrored counter-contrivance supplies the prepared answer embodied by the snare.
Non-haste lets the capture mechanism mature while movement continues.
Covering supplies concealment on the human side and echoes the snare's hidden operation.
Seeking and ranging for a thing supplies motion within the prepared field.

structural_cues: The mirrored schemes at 86:15-16 establish two tactical agents.
The repeated slowing at 86:17 follows rather than precedes the declaration of counter-design.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus branches for hunt and snare plus later concealment, schemes, seeking, and delay; I assign the arrow that treats delay as allowing the quarry to range inside a prepared capture field. A live alternative is that these remote branches are unrelated idioms and the ending concerns only moral patience.

changed_reading.before: The sky is a neutral location and the visitor simply crosses it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the upper field becomes hunt-space and the visitor a prepared snare whose delayed closure answers concealed maneuvering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses non-dominant narrow-aperture material for the first focus root and a difficult-birth branch for the second. It remains anchored to both focus words and is independently reactivated by penetration, outward displacement, and emergence in 86:3 and 86:6-7. Downstream prose should present it only as a branch-induced spatial topology, not as the lexical meaning of the sky or the identified star.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: At 86:1[1-2], a narrow opening and a partly obstructed emergence can form a single pressure-through-aperture scene.

activation_trace.role: A narrow opening supplies the aperture through which the focus event must pass.
Partial and difficult emergence supplies pressure and obstruction at that aperture.
Penetration through a hole reactivates the aperture as a traversed boundary.
An organ driven outward supplies a bodily analogue for pressure toward emergence.
Passing to the outside completes the aperture mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The star is simply visible in open sky.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, the focus can image a luminous body forcing emergence through a narrow upper boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a marked-season branch comes through a non-dominant mapping of the first focus root and shifts the oath from space to time. It remains anchored by the second root's habitual-turn branch and is reactivated by duration, return, and deliberate waiting. Downstream prose should call it a calendrical affordance, not claim that either focus noun literally means a calendar.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: At 86:1[1-2], a marked season and a recurring turn combine into a temporal marker.

activation_trace.role: A publicly marked season or gathering time supplies the temporal field.
A turn or habitual recurrence supplies the event that marks the season.
A bounded duration extends the focus relation into an appointed interval.
Return to a prior state gives the interval recurrence.
Measured waiting makes temporal delay operative rather than empty.

changed_reading.before: The oath points to two spatial objects visible at night.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, it can mark an appointed recurring turn whose arrival organizes waiting and return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus branch for divinatory striking and joins it to a split-root branch for discerning signs. It remains formally anchored and later hidden-line and indication branches make the mechanism coherent, but the surrounding discourse may expose or supersede such reading rather than authorize it. Downstream prose must frame this as an activated sign-reading foil, never as an endorsement of divination or a settled referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: At 86:1[1-2], a readable sign and a divinatory strike can generate a procedure for inferring what is hidden.

activation_trace.role: A sign read by discerning observation supplies the inferential surface.
Divinatory striking supplies the unusual procedure applied to the sign-bearing field.
Lines of palm or forehead provide a concrete trace-pattern that can be read.
Reaching hidden matters supplies the procedure's claimed target.
A thing indicating or saying its condition gives the read trace a putative message.

changed_reading.before: The sky-sign discloses itself directly through light.
changed_reading.after: As a contained foil, the focus can activate an indirect procedure that strikes or reads traces to infer concealed conditions.

strongest_changes: 86:2-3 converts an open night-arrival into luminous penetration while preserving the eventive force of the focus noun.
86:5-7 unexpectedly reactivates reproductive branches in both focus roots and expands them into a generation-discharge-emergence mechanism.
86:8 and 86:11-12 turn the focus's strike and habitual course into a return cycle linking upper recurrence with lower splitting.
86:9-17 permits forensic, acoustic, tactical, and hunt-space readings to coexist without cancelling the celestial baseline.
summary.what_was_special: Both focus roots contain ordinary celestial-spatial branches and unusually concrete alternatives. The context repeatedly supplies penetration, generation, guarded observation, return, exposure, articulated separation, counter-design, and delay, so several distinct mechanisms become live rather than collapsing into one star gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 86:3 exhaustively identifies the focus arrival or gives one privileged manifestation of a broader event-category.
How much semantic weight split-root inventories for visible marking, narrow apertures, and marked seasons can bear beyond serving as structural affordances.
Whether the human creation sequence genuinely retroactivates the focus pair or only provides a later analogy for power and return.
Whether the acoustic, hunt, calendrical, and sign-reading models remain productive after their branch distance is made explicit.
